title: Future of recruiting
finding: LinkedIn highlights skills-first hiring and AI-enabled recruiting as core developments shaping talent acquisition.

title: Advanced AI-Assisted Search: The Right Tool to Find the Right Candidates — Faster
finding: Recruiters can search in natural language; the system interprets hiring intent, identifies qualifications and can infer adjacent skills from experience even when exact keywords are absent.

title: See the Early Impact of LinkedIn’s First AI Agent: Hiring Assistant
finding: AI-assisted recruiting is reducing repetitive sourcing/review work and increasing the importance of clear, machine-readable evidence in candidate profiles.

title: Skills-based hiring
finding: Skills-first hiring puts greater emphasis on demonstrated capabilities and potential rather than relying only on traditional proxies such as titles or pedigree.

title: 2025 B2B Thought Leadership Impact Report
finding: Thought leadership can influence both visible and hidden decision-makers; useful, perspective-shifting ideas can help lesser-known brands gain advocacy.

title: Reach Beyond The Ready: B2B Thought Leadership Research
finding: Senior decision-makers spend meaningful time consuming thought leadership and become more receptive to outreach from organizations that consistently produce high-quality insight.

title: Creating Helpful, Reliable, People-First Content
finding: Google emphasizes original analysis, first-hand expertise, clear purpose, satisfying page experience and content created primarily for people rather than search engines.

title: Executive Search
finding: Senior executive assessment focuses on track record, functional and marketplace knowledge, leadership ability, character, motivation, cultural fit and capacity to grow with the role.

title: Board and CEO
finding: Board and CEO advisory work emphasizes future-ready skills, technical expertise, lived experience, succession readiness and strategic contribution.

title: 29th Global CEO Survey: Middle East findings
finding: Middle East and GCC CEOs report strong growth confidence, elevated AI adoption and increased focus on data readiness, governance, resilience and capability-led growth.

title: EMEA Cloud Business Survey: Middle East Findings
finding: Cloud is increasingly treated as a strategic platform for AI, resilience and sovereignty; regional organizations report high cloud maturity and continued investment.

title: 88% of CEOs in the Middle East confident in growth
finding: Regional leaders are deploying capital, scaling AI and building capabilities while balancing growth, cybersecurity and risk.
